title: 3  Databases
text:
4.1 hwConfig.db
This is a quasi static database. The database is created on boot. You find the serial numbers here. The sensors will be detected and updated by “detect sensors” in the system menu. Slots 0 and 1 can be set manually, for example if you use current clamps instead of electrodes, by loading the user configuration.  The mobile web interface can only work with detected sensors.

4.1.1 adu
About the systems and their capabilities.  Sample frequencies and digital apply to ALL channels, so they are here.
{
  "system_type": "ADU-11e",
  "serial": 0
}


4.1.2 slot
About the slots and their capabilities.  Gains and channel types are per slot, so they are here. You will find slot0 to slot4 or up to slot7 depending on your system. 
{
  "board_type": "ADU-11E-BB",
  "serial": 0,
  "sensor_type": "",
  "sensor_serial:": 0
}
“detect sensors” will update the sensor type and serial. For slot0 and slot1 sensor type can be set manually. chopper is e.g. -1 : ket the ADU decide (0 == off, 1 == on).

title: 3  Databases
text:
4.4 userConfig.db
This is a user editable database. Quickly reload user defined settings. Slots 0, 1 can be set here; This is useful in case you don’t use electrodes (which are already set to EFP-06), for example current clamps.
An example for massive AMT data collection in UTC:
{
  "grid_mode": "on",
  "utc_offset": "00:00",
  "dst": "off",
  "sensor_type_slot_0": "StROD",
  "sensor_type_slot_1": "StROD",
  "gain_slot_0": 0,
  "gain_slot_1": 0,
  "ns_pos": 25.0,
  "ew_pos": 25.0
}
Your electric field is pre-configured, start time is on the 64 grid, gains 0 accepts the auto gain from the system, and off you go!
You can select a gain, in case you have current clamps: mostly take 1 and sensor type clamp.

title: 4  Slots Flow
4  Slots Flow
text:
4.3 Resulting Channels:

E: 0, 1
MT: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
AMT: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
Airborne: 2, 3, 4
Airborne: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
Airborne: 3, 4, 5
ALL: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7

Airborne is a synonym for MT without E sensors. So for a remote reference station or GDS (geomagnetic deep sounding) you can use the airborne mode.  E is a synonym for electric field only. Either for EMAP or current measurements.  MT /AMT is a synonym for magnetotelluric mode, so electric and magnetic field.

title: 5  ADC
text:
5.2 Summary

The first two connectors (S → N and E → W) are always on the same slots (0 and 1) and are always associated with the channels 0 and 1, aka Ex and Ey.
The connectors (Hx, Hy, Hz) are on slots 2, 3, and 4 and if a sensor is detected, are associated with channels 2, 3, and 4.
The connectors (MP Hx, MP Hy, MP Hz) are on slots 5, 6, and 7 and if a sensor is detected:

are associated with channels 2, 3, and 4 if Hx, Hy, Hz are not detected
are associated with channels 5, 6, and 7 if Hx, Hy, Hz are detected


Go back to the slots flow for more details on the slot configuration and resulting channels.
